name: draftMedicalNote
shortDescription: Assists doctors in drafting medical notes for a patient's EHR based on provided symptoms and history.
description:
Overview

Aids doctors in composing medical notes for a patient's EHR by leveraging patient history, symptoms, and observations to suggest content.

Intended use

Called by the doctor-facing UI as an AI-assist tool during patient consultations or EHR updates. It receives patientId, symptoms, and observations.

Logic

  1. Retrieve relevant historical MedicalRecord and Patient data based on params.patientId.
  2. Combine this historical data with the provided params.symptoms and params.observations to form a comprehensive context.
  3. (Hypothetical AI step): Send this combined context to an internal AI service (e.g., ctx.ai.generate_note) to draft a preliminary medical note.
  4. Return the drafted medical note content for the doctor to review, edit, and finalize.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • Patient
  • Doctor
